description.narrative: This support measure constitutes the fifth and final Annual Action Programme (AAP 2026) under the EU¿South Africa Multiannual Indicative Programme 2021¿2027, with a total EU contribution of EUR 4 million. It aims to support the programming, implementation, monitoring, evaluation and visibility of the EU¿South Africa Strategic Partnership, including the Global Gateway Investment Package, the Clean Trade and Investment Partnership and the Memorandum of Understanding on Critical Raw Materials, and to maintain the momentum generated by the EU¿South Africa Summit and high¿level engagements in 2025. The action is structured around two complementary pillars:A cooperation facility to underpin strategic and policy dialogue, strengthen the quality and coherence of the EU project portfolio and support ongoing and forthcoming programming, project preparation, monitoring, audit and evaluation. A strategic communication component to measurably enhance awareness, understanding and perception of the EU and its partnership with South Africa, particularly through large¿scale, campaign¿driven communication activities.
